settings.heading: The right yak chew for your Beagle.
settings.subheading: Beagles are food-motivated, persistent chewers. They need a chew that keeps them engaged without being too large for their compact frame.
settings.estimate_note: Beagles (20–30 lbs) are methodical gnawers. Most do well with a Small or Medium. Their food drive means they stay engaged longer than many breeds.
settings.card_1_text: Most Beagles weigh 20–30 lbs. A Small works for lighter Beagles; a Medium is better for larger ones. Their persistent gnawing style means chews last longer than you might expect.
settings.card_2_text: Beagles are scent hounds with strong food drive. A yak chew satisfies their need to work for food — it is enrichment and reward in one. Great for redirecting counter-surfing behavior.
settings.card_3_text: When the chew gets to a 1-inch nub, microwave it for 45–60 seconds. Beagles go wild for the puffed treat — it is like a bonus reward that extends every chew session.
